epics.title: Idea and research
epics.summary: Register the feature, ground claims and preserve source evidence.

epics.title: Design and ADR
epics.summary: Complete required simulation and machine-readable agent panel reviews; retain current owner policy until changed.

epics.title: Task DAG
epics.summary: Validate Atlas task dependencies, scopes and acceptance commands.

epics.title: Implementation control
epics.summary: Constrain worktrees and bound executor attempts without adding a service.

epics.title: Verification
epics.summary: Require executed deterministic evidence followed by a blocking cross-model verdict.

epics.title: Integration
epics.summary: Wire CI, PR policy and main failure handling to immutable SHAs.

epics.title: Release and acceptance
epics.summary: Generate the product package and reserve policy activation/publication for the owner.

tasks.title: Register autonomous delivery feature and acceptance scenarios
decisions: Use existing GitCore ledger and SRS; status starts planned.
One code PR references this feature ID or a bounded part.
tasks.current_state: No durable feature contract for DONE.
tasks.desired_state: Acceptance scenarios, REQ mapping and planned ledger entry exist.
acceptance: Ledger entry is planned and maps to the spec and SRS.
No status is hand-promoted.
Task changes at most 4 files and 400 lines.

tasks.title: Ground pipeline claims and intake evidence
decisions: Use Atlas evidence strings and CI artifacts for sources; do not invent a database.
External figures need source URL, date and independent recheck.
tasks.current_state: Research and intake rules are proposed but not independently checked.
tasks.desired_state: A checked source table and intake examples are embedded in the protocol.
acceptance: All measured claims have source pointers; assumptions are marked.
Independent agent verifies cited local facts and records report URL.
At most 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Independent fact review on a bounded document scope.

tasks.title: Run ADR-035 simulation and record agent panel report
decisions: Keep ADR proposed until the required simulation and current owner acceptance.
Panel approvals are a proposed policy amendment, not current authorization.
tasks.current_state: ADR simulation and agreement fields are PENDIENTE.
tasks.desired_state: Simulation command, seed, JSON/Markdown report digests and two independent panel verdicts are recorded without changing acceptance status.
acceptance: Execute the ADR's declared simulation command and preserve reports as linked artifacts.
Checker validates report presence, seed and no unresolved reviewer blocker.
Status stays proposed pending owner policy decision; at most 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Can run and report the required deterministic simulation.

tasks.title: Validate bounded DAG before Atlas import
decisions: Use the supplied JSON schema and Atlas IDs; no alternate task store.
Reject cycles, missing dependencies and tasks over 4 files; enforce 400 changed lines on the actual diff.
tasks.current_state: Atlas can hold tasks but does not enforce this delivery DAG contract.
tasks.desired_state: A deterministic pre-import validator rejects malformed/unbounded DAGs.
acceptance: Valid sample passes; cycle, orphan, path escape and oversize fixtures fail.
No task is marked complete by import.
At most 400 changed lines.

tasks.title: Enforce changed-path and public path-leak guards
decisions: Inspect actual base-to-head diff, staged/untracked files and task-known worktrees.
Scan added content/new blobs; fail closed on symlink and unknown file types.
tasks.current_state: Executor scope and personal path leaks are caught by manual review.
tasks.desired_state: A SHA-bound guard produces an evidence report and rejects scope/path leaks.
acceptance: Tests reject a second-checkout write, rename escape, out-of-scope path and private absolute path.
$HOME examples pass; non-text additions require review.
At most 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Security-sensitive filesystem guard needs focused implementation.

tasks.title: Bound executor launches and retry on another backend
decisions: Close stdin for noninteractive CLIs; two attempts total with different backends.
Heartbeat quiet commands; no-output and wall limits yield explicit failure.
tasks.current_state: Agents can hang on stdin or return zero bytes with no bounded recovery.
tasks.desired_state: Coordinator wrapper records each attempt, terminates hangs and blocks descendants after two failures.
acceptance: Fixtures detect stdin wait, zero-byte exit and timeout.
Second attempt uses a different backend and cannot widen scope.
At most 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Process control and failure accounting require a deterministic wrapper.

tasks.title: Wire ATLAS_REVIEW_CMD to co-agent-review.sh
decisions: Atlas reviewer is advisory; DONE checker independently blocks rejected/deferred verdicts.
PARTIAL from helper is rejection despite exit 0.
tasks.current_state: Unset ATLAS_REVIEW_CMD uses Atlas stub and helper success can mean PARTIAL.
tasks.desired_state: Adapter reads Atlas JSON stdin, invokes $HOME/.hermes/scripts/co-agent-review.sh and emits strict JSON verdict.
acceptance: approve, reject, PARTIAL, malformed, timeout and reviewer-unavailable fixtures produce expected verdicts.
Output is exact JSON; raw report is saved and SHA-bound.
At most 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Bridges existing reviewer protocols without modifying external tools.

tasks.title: Implement task DONE checks
decisions: Use immutable bundle schema; do not trust free-form Atlas evidence alone.
Deterministic command execution precedes cross-model review.
tasks.current_state: Atlas checks DoD/evidence presence but model rejection does not block completion.
tasks.desired_state: Task DONE requires scope, scans, observed commands/tests, Atlas rule pass and exact independent reviewer approval.
acceptance: Missing cargo, zero tests, stale SHA, missing scanner, stub/defer/PARTIAL all fail.
Green fixture emits machine-readable checks and exit 0.
At most 400 changed lines.

tasks.title: Add feature and increment closure checks
decisions: Full ledger must execute with cargo present before feature status is trusted.
Merged PR is not feature DONE until main is green.
tasks.current_state: Task-level evidence has no aggregate closure verifier.
tasks.desired_state: Feature/increment checks validate DAG closure, current-SHA CI, full ledger, incidents and package links.
acceptance: Green task with red main or open incident does not close increment.
Full verifier log proves declared tests executed; no hand promotion.
At most 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Aggregates task evidence using existing CI and ledger.

tasks.title: Wire DONE and full ledger into CI
decisions: Keep existing required safeguards until shadow gate is proven.
Required result must be attached to exact PR or main SHA.
tasks.current_state: CI does not invoke full feature ledger verification; no required DONE check.
tasks.desired_state: PR gets policy/task evidence check; main runs full ledger and feature/increment evidence artifacts.
acceptance: Docs-only and Rust PRs emit a stable check result; missing/skipped jobs fail closed.
Main workflow executes full ledger with cargo prerequisite and uploads logs.
At most 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: CI wiring must preserve existing gates and expose stable status.

tasks.title: Track red main runs and reversible recovery
decisions: One tbd-incident issue per failing SHA; no silent auto-merge of reverts.
Do not mechanically revert schema/data migrations or released tags.
tasks.desired_state: Failed main check opens/updates SHA-keyed incident with owner, run URL and fix/revert tracking.
acceptance: Simulated main failure creates one incident; repeated event deduplicates.
Incident closes only after linked green fix/revert SHA.
At most 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Bounded CI failure path and idempotency.

tasks.title: Generate Product Acceptance Package
decisions: One page generated from verified evidence; no green claims from prose.
Separate product acceptance from outward authorization.
tasks.current_state: Owner would need to inspect scattered PR/CI/Atlas records.
tasks.desired_state: Package has changes, trial steps, results, risks, rollback, links and decision block at one SHA.
acceptance: Red/missing evidence or broken required link prevents READY_FOR_ACCEPTANCE.
Source rollback differs from deployed binary/tag rollback.
At most 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Deterministic summary generation from the DONE bundle.

tasks.title: Activate branch rules (owner authorization of an outward change)
decisions: Owner decides whether agent panel can accept reversible ADR/Ask design.
Rule activation is an outward governance action.
tasks.current_state: ADR-035 proposed, Ask requires owner, main has no required checks. The governance amendment itself was confirmed by the owner on 2026-09-27 (AGENTS.md "Decision rights (agent panel)").
tasks.desired_state: Owner records decision; only then policy text and main ruleset reflect the approved scope.
acceptance: Owner reviews simulation and shadow gate evidence before deciding.
Trial rejects agent direct push, stale PR and unapproved Ask; preserves emergency owner path.
At most 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Policy acceptance and branch protection require owner authorization.

tasks.title: Review finished product and authorize outward release
decisions: Human reviews only the finished product package and explicitly authorizes any public tag/deployment/spend.
No publication is inferred from merge.
tasks.current_state: Candidate package is READY_FOR_ACCEPTANCE; public release/local install remains separate.
tasks.desired_state: Owner acceptance or concrete defect issue is recorded; any outward authorization is explicit.
acceptance: Owner receives one-page package and working trial steps.
Accept/reject and any release authorization are recorded separately.
Agents retain execution of authorized release steps.
tasks.agent_reason: Final product acceptance and irreversible/outward authorization are owner decisions.

tasks.title: Execute authorized release and close increment
decisions: Reuse existing release.yml or local deploy procedure after explicit owner authorization.
A Git revert does not undo an installed binary, data migration or public tag.
tasks.current_state: Product is accepted, but an authorized outward action may still be pending.
tasks.desired_state: Release agent executes only the authorized action and records artifact URL, SHA, checksum and rollback result.
acceptance: Authorization scope matches the actual tag/deploy target.
Release/deploy run and checksum are linked in Atlas and package.
Increment DONE is recomputed after action; failures open an incident.
tasks.agent_reason: Agent executes the bounded release operation after owner authorization.
